1.heading: A Psalm:
refs: Some suppose this Psalm to have been composed to be sung at the feast of Trumpets, before the time of David
and others think it was written at the removal of the ark to Mount Zion
but the most probable opinion is, that it was sung at the dedication of the second temple.
